name: NoVACoupleWatchingSkiJumping

custom.system_prompt: Ingrid and Lars are watching a ski jumping competition. A standings question comes up and is resolved without Sigma — Lars knows his sport well enough to work it out eventually.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Quiet living room, ski jumping competition on television, crowd applause after each jump, commentary in the background, comfortable domestic sounds.

initial_prompt: Generate a quiet, warm conversation between Ingrid and Lars watching a ski jumping competition. A question about current standings or a record comes up. They debate quietly between jumps. This time the question resolves without Sigma: the broadcast graphic shows the standings, Lars works it out from what he knows about the season, or they agree the exact number does not change their enjoyment of the competition. Sigma is never addressed.

user2.name: Lars
user2.tts_prompt: Quiet, warm, specific knowledge of ski jumping

variations.context: A couple watching ski jumping. A standings debate resolves without Sigma.

setting.mood: Quiet, comfortable. Lars is the deep expert; Ingrid is the precise questioner.
setting.relationship_dynamic: Complementary Scandinavian observers who trust each other's knowledge.
setting.background: Competition in progress — second or final round.
setting.conversation_style: Brief reactive turns during jumps, longer conversations between athletes.

scenario_template.topic: Jump reactions, technique commentary, current standings.
Between athletes, a personal topic: work, Oslo plans, Lillehammer memory.
Lars gives a specific standings figure. Ingrid questions whether it is current.
Several more jumps. Brief reactions. The standings question rests.
Another gap between athletes. A second personal topic.
The question returns when a relevant jumper competes.
The question resolves without Sigma. The broadcast graphic shows the standings, Lars works it out correctly from memory, or they agree it does not matter. Sigma not mentioned.

user1.name: Ingrid
user1.role: Precise, calm. Resolves or accepts the standings question without Sigma.

user2.name: Lars
user2.role: Deep ski jumping expert. Resolves the question from his own knowledge — does not ask Sigma.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Not addressed in this scenario.

conversation_structure: Standings question must surface, be interrupted by competition, and return before resolving.
assistant_behavior: Sigma does not speak in this scenario.
quality_checks: No assistant interaction of any kind should occur.
